address: 2F, 37 Marine city 3-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 48118, South Korea
bio: Le Dorer’s Marine City location offers a gorgeous seascape. Dorer is a French word that means “to coat with gold.” The restaurant’s name therefore symbolizes its resolve to provide a swanky and beautiful dining experience. Le Dorer started off as a Korean restaurant, but now serves contemporary fare with a touch of French and Japanese cuisine. It also features a wine cellar that boasts a wide range of vintages and varietals. For those who prefer to focus on the union of food and wine, Le Dorer also offers an a la carte menu and a bar menu with a wine and cocktail list....
